text: Add impression-time request-context fields tab, hour, and weekday to the neutral user/video additive scorer; the measured train-only temporal screen reports a +0.00221 primary lift with full coverage and positive lift on all four holdout dates.
rationale: This is the most directly supported candidate: screen:request_context measured a positive aggregate primary lift of 0.002213 with 100% coverage and positive daily lifts on every screened date. The change is small, ranking-relevant, and easy to isolate.
exact_ablation: Add only the impression-time request_context fields tab, hour, and weekday; keep the additive user/video model, optimizer, loss, and training schedule unchanged.

expected_effect.GAUC: Likely increase, approximately +0.002 to +0.004, because the screened feature group improved within-user discrimination.
expected_effect.nDCG@5: Small increase or flat, approximately -0.001 to +0.002, because the screening showed stronger GAUC evidence than top-five evidence.
